user.title: Ergon Energy outages
user.description: Choose the spot to watch, usually your home. Any Ergon outage area that touches the circle is reported. Drag the circle edge to set the radius; a few hundred metres is recommended.

data_description.name: Used in entity names, e.g. Home gives binary_sensor.ergon_outages_home_outage_now.
data_description.scan_interval: Ergon refreshes its outage map roughly every 15 minutes.
